title: Get QuartzOS Running on iOS Simulator
description: Fix all build errors, install dependencies, and launch the quartzos-app on an iOS simulator.

stories.title: Install Ruby 3.x via rbenv
stories.description: System Ruby is 2.6.10 which is too old for CocoaPods ffi (requires >= 3.0). Install rbenv and Ruby 3.3.
acceptanceCriteria: rbenv is installed and available in PATH
rbenv global is set to Ruby 3.3.x

stories.title: Install CocoaPods with Ruby 3.x
stories.description: With Ruby 3.x available, install the cocoapods gem.
acceptanceCriteria: CocoaPods installed using rbenv's Ruby 3.x, not system Ruby

stories.title: Run pod install in ios/ directory
stories.description: Install all iOS native dependencies via CocoaPods.
acceptanceCriteria: `pod install` completes without errors in ios/

stories.title: Boot iOS Simulator
stories.description: Boot an iPhone simulator ready for running the app.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one iPhone simulator is in 'Booted' state
`xcrun simctl list devices | grep Booted` shows an iPhone

stories.title: Build and Launch App on Simulator
stories.description: Build the Expo/React Native app and launch it on the booted simulator.
acceptanceCriteria: App builds successfully (no fatal build errors)
App launches and is visible on the iOS simulator
